verdict.rationale: Khoj's 'Automations' feature lets users schedule queries to run automatically at set times/frequencies, with results delivered via email — this is time-based automation, not true event-driven triggers reacting to arbitrary events. There's no evidence of rule-based triggers firing on external events (e.g., file changes, webhooks, API calls) beyond the fixed schedule model. Missing for 10: event-based/webhook triggers, conditional rule logic, integration with external event sources beyond scheduled cron-like runs.
